items.name: Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game
items.description:
Catch the fish. Watch it jump. Take the shot.

Catch & Shoot: Fishing Game brings fishing and midair target shooting together in short 3D sessions. Cast your line, hold to reel in a fish and manage the line tension. When it leaps from the water, aim and shoot before it gets away.

Discover 10 different fish and fill your Fish Collection. Each new catch reveals a collection card, while repeat catches add to your total and bring you closer to unlocking another weapon.

items.name: world of Slime: Chewy MMORPG

Tame and synthesize slimes as you explore an uncharted world.
A cozy taming MMORPG where you can enjoy laid-back adventures with friends

Slimes can only be found by taming and synthesizing them, never through random draws.
Synthesis offers a different kind of fun from evolution. Discover new slime combinations!

Ride slimes across rivers, get past obstacles, and solve puzzles.
Travel every corner of a squishy, charming world.

items.name: Element Stack
items.description:
Element Stack is a quick, clever card game where five elements battle it out across four columns of cards. Play a card, beat the one underneath, and watch your score climb.

EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO PUT DOWN
Every turn you hold two cards. Drop one on a column. Match three of the same element in a row and they merge for bonus points. Play an element that beats the card on top and it conquers the whole run: Water beats Fire, Fire beats Wind, Wind beats Earth, Earth beats Lightning, and Lightning beats Water. items.name: Boxsum: Number Sum Puzzle
items.description:
Boxsum is a number puzzle you solve by counting.

You get a grid of numbers and a target. Find every rectangle of cells whose numbers add up to the target, then type how many there are. Drag across the board to box the ones you have found. You get three guesses, and a wrong one adds 30 seconds. Then the answer draws itself: every right rectangle, one pen stroke at a time.

It sounds simple. Then two rectangles overlap, a blank cell quietly pads a sum, and you were sure there were seven.

items.name: Pretendy: Kids Pretend Play
items.description:
Pretendy turns your iPhone into a little world of pretend play. Your child pours lattes in the café, scoops ice cream, flips pancakes, bakes pizza, looks after poorly pets, washes, colours and snips hair at the salon and answers questions at school, with Nuno the otter cheering them on.

items.name: Pushlings: Logic Puzzle Game
items.description:
Push a crate onto a glowing pad and the world changes: water turns into bridges, walls crumble into floor, goals appear. Pushlings is a cozy logic puzzle game about pushing blocks and bending the rules to reach the goal.

 HOW TO PLAY
Swipe or tap the arrows to move your Pushling. Push crates onto pads to switch their rules on, cross the bridges you make and step onto the goal. Plan ahead: a crate pushed into a corner stays there.

From gentle first steps to real brain teasers. Every level is checked to be solvable, and reaching the goal in par earns three stars.

items.name: Qualvio
items.description:
Qualvio is a sum puzzle: small numbers, moments that click.

The board is full of numbered tiles. The goal sits at the top. Link neighboring tiles — up, down, left, or right — until they add up to exactly what the level asks. Hit it and they vanish; the tiles above fall into place. Miss it and the board stays as it is, so you look for another path.

Protect the egg! A cozy miniature tower defense where a team of tiny spiders guards a silk-wrapped egg from waves of hungry bugs. New Generation Tower Defense (TD) Game!

- Web Weaver slows bugs down in sticky webs.
- Seed Spitter fires fast, single-target seeds.
- Acorn Mortar lobs acorns that splash whole groups.

items.name: Solitaire Streak
items.description:
Solitaire Streak is a fast, addictive card game of risk, deduction and luck.

There are 9 cards on the table. Eight are safe. One is the Joker.

Flip cards to reveal their values, complete rows and columns to earn powerful Hint Tokens, then use the clues to work out where the Joker is hiding.

Think you know where it is? Grab the Joker Stamp and make your move.

The earlier you stamp the Joker, the bigger your coin reward — but the less information you have to work with. Keep revealing cards to make the decision safer, or take the risk and go for a bigger payout.

items.name: Arkado: Offline Mini Games

Arkado is a pack of 10 original mini games you can play offline, anywhere. Play solo against smart bots, or pass one phone between 2–4 friends for quick party duels. No WiFi, no account, no waiting.

PLAY SOLO VS SMART BOTS
Every game has computer opponents with 3 difficulty levels, so you always have someone to beat. Single player offline games for the plane, the subway or anywhere without internet.

2 PLAYER GAMES ON ONE PHONE
5 turn-based games let 2–4 players share a single device. Make your move, hand the phone over and let the rivalry begin. Great for couples, friends, siblings and famil

items.name: ABORRO Gomoku

Five stones. One winning strategy.

items.name: Absorb the Universe
items.description:
You don't know what you are.

You know you are hungry. You know you are fading. Whatever is smaller than you can be swallowed, and each thing you swallow buys a little more time. Whatever is bigger wears a red ring. Stay away from those, until they aren't bigger any more.

Nothing here stays the same size. What you fled a minute ago is food now. What you took for everything turns out to be a speck, and something out there is already looking at you the same way.

Each time the scale shifts, you change. 26 mutations, none of them just bigger numbers. Some, brought together, become something else

items.name: Aether Drift: Feel the Flight

items.name: Altitude · Strategy Conquest
items.description:
Altitude is turn based 4X strategy on floating islands. Start with a capital and one Rifleman, claim the land around you, grow your towns from 1850 to 2050, and take every rival's last town. 14 nations, 45 units, 61 skills, 60 Climb floors. 100% ad-free, no sign-up, plays offline: pick a nation, claim your first island, play.

- Grow: build farms, mines, lumber camps and fisheries, and your towns level up

Anchorfall is an offline physics puzzle game set on open water.

You never steer the boat directly. Instead, throw an anchor, tune the chain length, and ride inertia, currents, and momentum to reach the dock.

• Use the slider to change chain length while anchored

items.name: Apex Dash Formula
items.description:
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a real-time telemetry dashboard for Formula racing games.

Apex Dash Formula delivers clean, customizable dashboards designed for every session — from focused racing displays to dedicated cockpit, tire and vehicle damage views.

Build the smartest AI on Earth. Try not to end it.

Your AI (name it whatever you like) is with you the whole way. Early on it reorganizes the snack drawer and names the office plant Gerald. Later it asks why the off switch has a cover on it.

items.name: Air Island
items.description:
In Air Island, you build a settlement on a small island above the clouds. A crystal called the Gravitator keeps it afloat, but it needs repairs. How will you spend your first gold coins and use your supplies? Will you build a house for new arrivals, plant a lime tree to make life a little sweeter, or set some gold aside to repair the crystal?

Every patch of land counts. A windmill helps your settlement earn more gold, but it also adds to pollution. Trees clean the air and keep the islanders happy. How well your settlement is doing determines when you can tackle the next repair.

items.description:
Arkaball brings classic Arkanoid-style brick breaking to iPhone and iPad. The paddle is at the bottom, a brick wall is at the top, and the ball bounces between them. Slide the paddle with your finger to send the ball back into the wall. Let it slip past and you lose a life.

Some bricks break on the first hit. Others take a few more. When there’s just one brick left near the side, try catching the ball with the edge of your paddle to send it off at a sharper angle. Clear the wall and another one awaits. The game gets faster as you go.

items.description:
In Bubbles, aim with your finger and lift it to shoot. Hit a group of two or more bubbles that match the colour of yours and the whole group pops. Any bubbles left hanging without support fall with it.

In Puzzle mode, you have a limited number of shots to clear each pattern. Before you shoot, check which colour is coming next. Sometimes it pays to leave a gap for your next shot. items.name: Air Island - Xonix

Keep an eye on the whole clearing. While you’re tapping a lime tree for the second time, a spruce might already be peeking out a few stumps away. Watch out for bees, though. Hit one and you lose a life.

items.name: Ali's Farm

Cows, ewes, goats, hens and their rooster, beehives, and a dog that guards the coop… because at night, the fox is on the prowl! Fill the troughs and the dog's bowl, and collect milk, eggs, honey and truffles.

But you can capture the Angry Gorilla to attack other players so they are sent back to the beginning of the trail.

items.name: Blast Off: Rocket Defender
items.description:
Defend your launch site in BLAST OFF, a bright, fast arcade shooter for iPhone and iPad!

Fly 20 missions across the Solar System and beyond. Start at the launch site, then head through low Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars, the asteroid belt, Jupiter, Saturn's rings, the Neptune storm and the Crab Nebula. Finish by taking on the giant alien mothership.

Tap anywhere to fire a rocket right there, or hold and drag to aim with rapid fire. Satellites, ringed planets, wobbly UFOs, diving comets and tumbling space junk streak across the sky. Hit the mission goal before three get past!

items.name: Buddha Blast
items.description:
Barbarian raiders pour in from every side, and the Buddha walks calmly among them.

Lotuses circle the Buddha as you walk. Each one that touches a raider softens their anger, until they drop the axe and sit down as a monk. Gather the karma they leave behind to gain insight and grow stronger.

Make the workshop your own:
- Try six types of shoes.
- Unlock collection tools and larger carts.
- Choose different conveyor belts and styles.
- Use boosts for full-power stomps, more cans on the ground, or faster belts.

Paula the little mouse loves playing hide-and-seek!
Her friends begin a big search to find Paula, who always wanders off to faraway places.

Classic snake. A cosmic twist.

Guide your serpent, collect food, and keep growing through a cosmic arcade challenge. Every bite makes you longer. Every turn leaves less room for error.

Cosmic Serpent brings the familiar appeal of snake to iPhone and iPad with a space-inspired look and progressively challenging gameplay. Plan your path, keep your timing sharp, and see how far you can go before your own tail catches up with you.

Whether you have a minute to spare or a high score to chase, there’s always room for one more run.

Begin the hunt.

items.name: Cribbage @ the Table
items.description:
Play cribbage at the table against one, two or three computer opponents: two-, three- or four-handed, with four players either in partnerships or each for themselves.

SIX CHARACTERS
Ned, Pip, Tilly, Hazel, Mabel and Rook each play their own way. They differ in skill, in how much risk they take in the pegging, in what they throw to the crib, and in how they read the board. Each plays at Gentle, Usual or Sharp, and each has a few words to say at the table.

items.name: Elite Equestrian Championships

Saddle up for Tatum Safa's Elite Equestrian Championships: a 3D show-jumping game where you care for your horse, ride clear rounds and compete for the championship, featuring original songs by StormGurl.

RIDE REAL SHOW-JUMPING COURSES
Steer with your left thumb and tap Jump at just the right takeoff spot. Get it right and your horse soars; too close or too far and the rails come down. Rounds follow real FEI rules: faults for knockdowns, refusals and going over the time allowed.

Every great civilization begins somewhere.

But the world is much larger than your borders.

Across distant seas lie undiscovered lands, ancient mysteries, and a towering Great Ice Wall guarding the unknown.

Extreme Sudoku works differently. It turns your iPhone or iPad into a Sudoku generator. Create a fresh puzzle whenever you want one, from a reproducible seed, with a verified solution generated entirely on your device.

START SMALL OR GO EXTREME
Beginners and younger players can begin with compact 4×4, 6×6, and 8×8 boards, move through classic 9×9 Sudoku, then explore 16×16, 25×25, generalized rectangular layouts, and much larger experimental configurations.

items.name: Flag Shout Pro: Quiz by Voice

Take on the flag quiz and answer with your voice!
A quick, snappy, ad-free time attack game.

◆ Two game modes

Basic 50 flags: 
This game uses basic flags that you should be able to recognize.

All 201 flags:
This game uses all flags on this App.

A flag appears on the screen. Just say the name of the country or region out loud. Your iPhone or iPad hears your voice through its microphone and takes it as your answer.

Say "Hint" to see the first letter of the name. If you're really stuck, say "Pass" to move on to the next flag.

• Swipe in one of four directions. Matching pieces merge, and after every move a new one arrives.

Hit the beach, jump from a transport plane, ride in by helicopter or push up the river. Move with your squad, use cover and bring the right weapon for the job.
